machine: Amazon Linux 2023, Node.js 24.15.0, Docker 29.7.2 (containerd image store), buildx 0.38.0, Heroku CLI 11.12.0, 8 GiB swap file, TMPDIR on EBS
stacktapeBuild: Built on the WSL development machine with Node.js 24.15.0, pnpm 11.17.0 and Bun 1.4.1 as in "Build Stacktape from source", then copied to the runner.
stacktapeConsole: dev Console API (https://dev-api.stacktape.com), AWS account connection stacktape-e2e
order: setup of all 33 tests (not measured), one stream per tool
Render Git push lanes (one per app, ten cold/warm pairs) beside the local phases
Lambda packaging, serially: per app, per tool, ten clean then ten warm runs; then container image sizes
Lambda CLI deploys, alone: per app, ten rounds, rotating the tool order and alternating handler/shared
container CLI deploys: one lane per app in parallel, ten rounds, rotating the tool order

memory.note: Whole-machine samples every 250 ms per run (bench.mjs sampleMemory). Page size 4 KiB. See memory.md.

stacktapeImageSize: stacktape package fails with codeSwap: true, so the two Stacktape image-size rows were packaged with codeSwap removed (codeSwapOptIn: false, note in the row). The images the code-swap services ran are in stacktape-running-images.json.
unmeasuredSmokeDeploys: One deploy of each Stacktape container app after setup, into a separate results directory, to confirm code swap worked with this build. All three swapped.
notRerun: Stacktape Git push (dev Console runner not updated)
Serverless, SST and CDK Git push (GitHub Actions)
